Chat request with max_tokens=1 terminates with length finish_reason

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"max_tokens\":1,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Write a story\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(req)
    println(result.choices.first().finishReason)
    println(result.choices.first().message.content)
}
```
